issues: Table 1 lists 93 distinct named towns, matching the stated survey count; only 39 have explicit full inventory rows in Tables 3–10.
Table 1 has 大畈 and 慈口 as five-tone points, but Tables 6–8 give no complete inventories for them. Do not copy a nearby town inventory.
Table 3 omits 九岭 despite its seven-tone count in Table 1. Do not infer its pitches from 马港.

Transcription-review correction: initial low-resolution inspection misread 阴 as 阳 in 刘仁八 and 大幕. High-resolution crops and independent PDF text agree on 阴去35 and 阴去213 respectively; the source itself has no contradiction here.
Table 7 龙港 checked category printed 人声; raw preserved and held from directly published category labels.
Table 16 repeats 马港 with differing lexical forms. No word forms are extracted here.
The paper discusses former administrative 蒲圻, renamed 赤壁 in1998. Town identities and coordinates must be verified separately.
No sampling dates, speaker demographics, audio or representative syllables are provided by these tone-inventory tables.
classificationNote: The primary paper identifies southeastern Hubei Gan with the historical Da–Tong branch, with scope set out on printed p94. County clusters below this branch are geographic collections, not linguistic subdivisions.
nameNote: No local place-name IPA is supplied by these tables. The English labels are conventional romanized geographic labels, never claimed as community endonyms or HanLingo readings.
